Yesterday, we stood alongside neighbors, parents, elders, elected officials, school administrators, Community Board 18 and precinct council members, faith leaders, and so many others to demand answers from @nycmayor. 

After more than a year of organizing, the city made plans for a 200-unit shelter near a middle school public, without showing up to answer residents’ questions beforehand. On top of deceitful statements from the private developer

The message is clear: Canarsie deserves transparency and accountability from City Hall. We are calling on @nycmayor to come to Canarsie and answer our questions.

Councilmember @mercedesnarcisse Office is co-hosting an emergency meeting this Thursday, November 12, at 7 PM, at the Hebrew Educational Society (9502 Seaview Avenue). Thanks to all partners for co-leading. 

We encourage every neighbor to spread the word, attend and make their voice heard.

You know when you're so stressed that every little thing sets you off? That was me, rage texting my sister in law. 

I was so overwhelmed with stress from work and I started taking it out on her.

That’s when I knew I needed to go back to the tools Dr. @marc.brackett shared with me on @themelrobbinspodcast.

Comment ‘STRESS’ and I'll send you the full episode.

One of my favorites is this question:

How am I going to feel about this in a month?

Try it the next time you feel yourself getting worked up. It will help you get some perspective BEFORE you say or do something you regret.

🎧 “How to Master Your Emotions & Never Get Angry or Bothered by Anyone”

Follow (US) @MEMEZAR for more ❤️ He was about to start BARKING 😭

During a live awards broadcast, the camera pans across the auditorium, capturing audience members smiling and applauding. The moment takes an unexpected turn when streamer IShowSpeed appears in the crowd, looking noticeably out of place among the formally dressed attendees.

The camera briefly focuses on Speed before quickly switching to a wide shot of the stage. The sudden change in framing makes the moment hilarious, as viewers joke that the broadcast crew immediately realized who they had captured and knew they needed to change the shot before it became awkward.

caption.text:
Hundreds gathered at Chicago’s Millennium Park on Sunday for “Push the Bean,” a joke event encouraging people to move the city’s famous Cloud Gate sculpture seven inches to the left.

The gathering began with a viral flyer referencing an internet joke about a man supposedly trapped inside the sculpture, suggesting that moving it could reveal a hidden door to pass him supplies.

Despite the crowd’s efforts, The Bean didn’t budge.
